summary: Alaska State Troopers report four incidents in the Fairbanks area on Sunday: a drink-driving arrest on the Johansen Expressway in which four passengers were cited for minor consuming alcohol, a hotel disturbance ending in harassment and escape charges, a domestic violence assault arrest at North Pole, and an injury collision at mile 8 of the Elliott Highway. The Fairbanks court opened eleven criminal cases during Sunday and heard seven arraignments on its weekend calendar; seven of the eleven carry charges and four record no charging document. Eight of the eleven appear on neither daily police feed. The Alaska Court System's weekly charges report for Nov. 15-21 lists 36 criminal cases filed at Fairbanks and none at Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction; its window closes on Nov. 21 and so does not include any of Sunday's eleven filings. Fairbanks Police reported nothing for Sunday.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest: Lisa Anne Wright
body: Lisa Anne Wright, 37, of North Pole, is charged with assault in the fourth degree, recklessly causing injury to another person, a Class A misdemeanor flagged domestic violence related, and with violating conditions of release, a Class B misdemeanor. North Pole, Nov. 22 at about 8:30 a.m.; Alaska State Troopers.

Troopers say they received a report of a domestic violence assault, that their investigation found Wright had assaulted her significant other causing visible injuries, and that she was also in violation of her conditions of release by consuming alcohol. They say she was arrested and taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Case 4FA-26-02334CR. Arraignment held Nov. 22; pre-trial conference Jan. 7, 2027 and trial week Jan. 19, 2027 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

entries.title: Burglary charge: Ian Ray Woods
body: Ian Ray Woods is charged with burglary in the second degree, entering or remaining unlawfully in a building intending to commit a crime, a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. He is also charged with criminal mischief in the fifth degree, damaging property worth less than $250, a Class B misdemeanor. Fairbanks, offense dated Nov. 22.
Case 4FA-26-02330CR. Arraignment held Nov. 22; preliminary hearings set for Dec. 2 and Dec. 10, 2026.

entries.title: Harassment, escape and criminal mischief charges after a hotel disturbance
body: A woman was charged with harassment in the first degree, escape in the fourth degree and criminal mischief in the fourth degree after a disturbance at the Best Western Hotel in Fairbanks on Nov. 22. Troopers have not released her name and no charge class is recorded.

Troopers say she was intoxicated and had activated a fire alarm without authorization, that she fled from troopers and was detained, that she later spat blood-tinged saliva into a trooper's face, and that while being taken to Fairbanks Memorial Hospital she removed a hand from her handcuffs. Trooper case AK26114974.

entries.title: Drink-driving arrest and four citations on the Johansen Expressway
body: A driver was charged with driving under the influence, with an offense the dispatch types MOCA, and with driving while license revoked after a stop on the Johansen Expressway just west of College Road on Nov. 22 at about 1:40 a.m. Troopers have not released the driver's name. Four of five passengers were issued citations for minor consuming alcohol.

Troopers say two vehicles were seen on the shoulder, the front one with a license plate hanging off it that did not belong to that vehicle, and that contact was made with two drivers and five passengers, one driver and all five passengers being under the influence of alcohol. They say the driver was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. Trooper case AK26114969.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Levi Richard Heller
body: Levi Richard Heller is charged with assault in the fourth degree, recklessly causing injury to another person, and with assault when a child is present, both Class A misdemeanors and both flagged domestic violence related. Fairbanks, offense dated Nov. 21.
Case 4FA-26-02333CR. Arraignment held Nov. 22; pre-trial conference Jan. 7, 2027 and trial week Jan. 19, 2027 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

entries.title: Violating a protective order: William Doug Burgess
body: William Doug Burgess is charged with violating a domestic violence protective order, a Class A misdemeanor, flagged domestic violence related. Fairbanks, offense dated Nov. 22.
Case 4FA-26-02332CR. Arraignment held Nov. 22; pre-trial conference Jan. 14, 2027 and trial week Jan. 25, 2027.

entries.title: Two assault charges: Lyle Gibbons
body: Lyle Gibbons is charged with two counts of assault in the fourth degree, recklessly causing injury to another person, both Class A misdemeanors. Neither count is flagged domestic violence related. Fairbanks, offense dated Nov. 22.
Case 4FA-26-02329CR. Arraignment held Nov. 22; pre-trial conference Jan. 7, 2027 and trial week Jan. 19, 2027 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Frederick Trent Mayo
body: Frederick Trent Mayo, 56, is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree, entering or remaining unlawfully on premises, and with violating conditions of release, both Class B misdemeanors. 1300 block of South University Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 21 at 3:30 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Police case 26003536; court case 4FA-26-02328CR, opened Nov. 22. Arraignment held Nov. 22; pre-trial conference Dec. 31, 2026 and trial week Jan. 11, 2027 before Judge Matthew C. Christian.

entries.title: Trespass arrest: Timothy Royal Bidwell
body: Timothy Royal Bidwell, 50, is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree, entering or remaining unlawfully on premises, a Class B misdemeanor, and with violating a condition of release for a felony, a Class A misdemeanor. 1300 block of South University Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 21 at 2:01 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Police case 26003535; court case 4FA-26-02331CR, opened Nov. 22. Arraignment held Nov. 22; pre-trial conference Jan. 7, 2027 and trial week Jan. 19, 2027 before Judge Ben A. Seekins.

entries.title: Domestic violence arrest near Goldstream
body: A man was arrested on domestic violence charges at a residence in the Goldstream area north of Fairbanks on the evening of Nov. 21 and was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center. Troopers have not released his name and no charge class is recorded.

Troopers say they were called to the residence at about 9:03 p.m. for a report of a domestic violence assault and that their investigation found the man had committed multiple domestic violence crimes. Trooper case AK26114935.

entries.title: Driving on a revoked license: summonses after a Richardson Highway stop
body: A driver was issued criminal summonses for driving while license revoked and for failing to install a court-ordered ignition interlock device after a traffic stop on the Richardson Highway near the Badger Road 1 exit on Nov. 21. Troopers have not released the driver's name. Driving while license revoked means driving after a court or the state has taken the license away.

Troopers say they stopped the vehicle after seeing it travel 73 mph in a 60 mph zone, that the license was revoked, that the required interlock device had not been installed, and that no proof of insurance was produced. The vehicle was released to a licensed driver. A summons requires a court appearance; no arrest was made. Trooper case AK26114750.

entries.title: Injury collision at mile 8 of the Elliott Highway
body: Troopers say they received a report of a motor vehicle collision at mile 8 of the Elliott Highway on Nov. 22 at about 11:30 a.m., and that all occupants were taken to Fairbanks Memorial Hospital for treatment of injuries. The investigation is ongoing. No charge has been reported. Trooper case AK26115040.

entries.title: Four Fairbanks cases opened over the weekend with no charges filed
body: Four of the eleven criminal cases opened at the Fairbanks court on Nov. 22 record their only count as a charging document pending or not filed, with no statute and no degree of offense. The four are cases 4FA-26-02324CR, 4FA-26-02325CR, 4FA-26-02326CR and 4FA-26-02327CR, with offense locations of Fairbanks and offense dates of Nov. 21 and Nov. 22.

All four are set for arraignment on Nov. 27 at 8:30 a.m. at the Fairbanks courthouse. No charge is reported here for any of them because the court record states none, and no one named in the four is identified in this report for that reason.
